focus_area: Agent vulnerability scanning and penetration testing
recommendation: Implement continuous security validation with automated remediation
guidance: Periodic assessments leave newly deployed agent capabilities exposed for weeks or months. On-demand validation integrated into the development pipeline, paired with automated fix suggestions, compresses the discovery-to-resolution loop from weeks to hours.
how_to_check: • You run security validation continually or on-demand as part of the development and deployment pipeline rather than only during periodic assessment windows. • Validated findings arrive with ready-to-implement code fixes and configuration recommendations, so development teams remediate issues without waiting for security team intervention. • You track remediation progress automatically, and regression testing confirms fixes are effective and don't introduce new vulnerabilities. For more information, see the AGENTSEC09-BP03 documentation.
